subject: NaN fail-open fixed on the auth path; new gate in preflight+CI
body: Six sites in lib/webauthn read an unparseable expiry as VALID: both challenge verifies (server.ts:168,371), the challenge store read (store.ts:430, which used '!Number.isNaN(exp) &&' and so SKIPPED the check outright), the in-memory purge sweep (store.ts:366 — same guard, so malformed entries were never collected, reintroducing the unbounded growth that sweep exists to prevent), the step-up read (stepUpStore.ts:203), and a TTL computation (store.ts:469) that turned an unparseable expiry into a session with NO expiry. A seventh sat in lib/location/src/store.ts:22, where an undateable signal read as FRESH. All seven now treat unparseable as expired/stale. Also replaced the Math.random() lock token at store.ts:171 with randomUUID (note: the SET NX PX at :177 is what actually serialises writers, so this was the wrong primitive rather than the only guard). NEW SHARED SURFACE: scripts/check-nan-fail-open.mjs is registered in preflight AND review-hub-ci.yml, so the preflight gate count and the parity check both move — rebase before you touch either. The gate is self-tested with four rules and, run against the pre-fix sources, independently rediscovers all seven at their reported line numbers. Two things worth carrying: (1) my first regression assertions checked only success===false, which passed identically with the defect planted back, because any rejection satisfies it — they now assert error==='Challenge expired'; (2) the gate initially flagged its own self-test fixtures, because a comment stripper that cuts at the first // slices its own indexOf("//") in half and desynchronises literal masking for the rest of the file. Single-pass scanner now. lib/webauthn/src/stepUpStore.ts is reachable by NO test runner (step-up is deferred), so that fix is held by the static gate alone.
